step1_analysis.description: A passive LC tank circuit consisting of a capacitor and an inductor with series resistance. It serves as the frequency-determining resonator for a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO).

paper_reference.title: Low-Power Low-Phase-Noise Differentially Tuned Quadrature VCO Design in Standard CMOS

Resonant Frequency (f0).description: The frequency at which the tank impedance is purely resistive (phase is zero).

sky130_expected.calculation: f0 = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=1nH and C=7.8pF, f0 is approximately 1.8 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeting the center of the paper's reported tuning range (1.8 GHz) by selecting appropriate L and C values.

Quality Factor (Q).description: The ratio of energy stored to energy dissipated per cycle, calculated as f0 / (3dB bandwidth).

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for the tank alone, but critical for the -143 dBc/Hz phase noise.

sky130_expected.calculation: Q = (2 * pi * f0 * L) / R. With L=1nH, f0=1.8GHz, R=1.13 ohm, Q is approximately 10.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A Q of 10 is typical for integrated spiral inductors in standard CMOS processes like SKY130.

Parallel Equivalent Resistance (Rp).description: The maximum impedance magnitude at resonance, determining the required active negative resistance.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the chosen L, C, and Q values to match the 1.8 GHz resonance.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the resonant frequency, maximum impedance (Rp), and Quality Factor (Q) of the LC tank using an AC current source.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC Tank Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param C_val=7.8p
.param L_val=1n
.param R_val=1.13

* DUT
C NET1 NET2 {C_val}
L1 NET2 NET3 {L_val}
R1 NET3 NET1 {R_val}

* Stimulus
Vgnd NET1 0 0
I1 0 NET2 AC 1

.control
ac lin 10000 1G 3G
let z_mag = mag(v(NET2))
let z_phase = 180/PI * cph(v(NET2))

* Find resonant frequency (phase = 0)
meas ac f0 when z_phase=0 fall=1

* Find max impedance (Rp)
meas ac z_max max z_mag

* Find 3dB frequencies for Q calculation
let z_3db = z_max / 1.41421356
meas ac f1 when z_mag=z_3db rise=1
meas ac f2 when z_mag=z_3db fall=1

* Calculate Q
let q_factor = f0 / (f2 - f1)
print f0 z_max q_factor
quit
.endc
.end
